_comment: The emtk forms of the G-factor calculator, drawn by emtk.view_form.draw_form over GFactorModel. This is the shared native calculator used by standalone and hosted callers.

sections.title: Channels
sections.description: How the two channels of the reference file are used.

sections.label: Flip VV/VH
sections.description: The file has VV and VH swapped: exchange the parallel and perpendicular channels consistently across the calculation and the plots.

sections.label: Background correction
sections.description: Subtract separate channel means of the background region before matching the tails.

sections.title: Tail matching
sections.description: Region of the fast-rotating reference whose VV/VH ratio gives G, the background region and the VH shift.

sections.label: Tail start (bin)
sections.description: First TAC bin of the tail region used to match the reference dye channels.

sections.label: Tail stop (bin)
sections.description: Last TAC bin of the tail region.

sections.label: Background start (bin)
sections.description: First TAC bin of the signal-free region used for each channel's background (needs Background correction).

sections.label: Background stop (bin)
sections.description: Last TAC bin of the background region (needs Background correction).

sections.label: VH shift (bins)
sections.description: Shift the VH time axis by this many TAC bins, fractional bins included (the Qt tool's 'Shift Perpendicular Decay').

sections.title: Manual G
sections.description: Use a G-factor of your own instead of the calculated one.

sections.label: Manual G
sections.description: Use the G-factor typed below instead of the calculated one (the Qt tool does this when its G field is edited).

sections.label: G used
sections.description: Positive detector sensitivity ratio used for the corrected anisotropy.

sections.title: Slow-reference mixing
sections.description: Linked polarization-mixing estimate l1 = l2 from the slow protein reference and the Perrin relation.

sections.label: dt (ns/bin)
sections.description: Nanoseconds per slow-reference bin.

sections.label: rho (ns)
sections.description: Rotational correlation time used in the Perrin relation.

sections.label: r0
sections.description: Limiting (fundamental) anisotropy of the reference fluorophore.

sections.label: Manual lifetime
sections.description: Override the intensity first-moment lifetime of the slow reference.

sections.label: tau (ns)
sections.description: Lifetime used in place of the estimate.

sections.label: Manual target rS
sections.description: Override the Perrin steady-state anisotropy target.

sections.label: Target rS
sections.description: Steady-state anisotropy the slow reference should have.

sections.label: Manual l1 = l2
sections.description: Override the single linked polarization-mixing parameter.

sections.label: l1 = l2
sections.description: Linked mixing parameter applied to l1 and l2.

sections.label: Link l1 = l2
sections.description: Keep l1 and l2 linked when adjusting mixing manually.

sections.label: l1
sections.description: Manual mixing parameter l1.

sections.label: l2
sections.description: Manual mixing parameter l2.

sections.title: Calibration results
sections.description: Calibrated detector G-factor and polarization-mixing factors l1, l2.
Quantity and value of the G-factor and polarization-mixing calibration.

columns.title: Value
columns.tooltip: The value for the current settings.

sections.title: VV/VH files
sections.description: Queue files from disk, a folder or the database; remove or clear inputs without deleting their files.

options.add_tip: Choose VV/VH decay files to add.

sections.description: Anisotropy r(inf), region and status per queued file.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: Queued VV/VH decay; select and press Delete to remove it from the queue.

columns.title: r(inf)
columns.tooltip: Mean corrected anisotropy over the tail region with the frozen calibration.

columns.title: bg VV
columns.tooltip: Parallel background applied to this row.

columns.title: bg VH
columns.tooltip: Perpendicular background applied to this row.

columns.title: Error
columns.tooltip: Why the file could not be evaluated.

sections.title: Sample decay
sections.description: Inspect time-resolved anisotropy r(t) and r-infinity of the sample decay.

sections.label: r-inf start (bin)
sections.description: First bin of the region averaged to r-infinity.

sections.label: r-inf stop (bin)
sections.description: Last bin of the region averaged to r-infinity.

sections.label: r(inf)
sections.description: Mean anisotropy over the r-infinity region (five decimals).

sections.label: Applied G
sections.description: Detector G-factor applied to sample anisotropy.

sections.label: Applied l1
sections.description: Polarization mixing factor l1 applied to sample anisotropy.

sections.label: Applied l2
sections.description: Polarization mixing factor l2 applied to sample anisotropy.
